mapper.select: SELECT group_id AS groupId, group_name AS groupName, icon, dance_class_name AS danceClassName, leader_user_id AS leaderUserId, member_user_ids AS memberUserIds, leader_name AS leaderName, member_names AS memberNames, duty_desc AS dutyDesc, sort_order AS sortOrder, created_at AS createdAt FROM sys_work_group ORDER BY sort_order ASC, group_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_work_group (group_id, group_name, icon, dance_class_name, leader_user_id, member_user_ids, leader_name, member_names, duty_desc, sort_order, created_at) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{groupName}, #{icon}, #{danceClassName}, #{leaderUserId}, #{memberUserIds}, #{leaderName}, #{memberNames}, #{dutyDesc}, #{sortOrder}, NOW())
